name: Kimpton Rowan Palm Springs Hotel
positioning: Seven-story, pet-friendly Kimpton hotel with a rooftop pool, in downtown Palm Springs
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable downtown Palm Springs base with a rooftop pool
Guests traveling with pets or family

facts.text: The rooftop pool sits atop the seven-story hotel and has mountain views.
Juniper Table is the ground-floor eatery, with a counter-service bar for espresso and juice and a Cal-Med breakfast and lunch menu.
Poolside, guests can order from High Bar, which serves cocktails and a casual menu of burgers, hummus plates and lettuce wraps.
All rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows, and many have balconies.
The hotel is steps from the main drag and within walking distance of most Palm Springs highlights, including shopping, dining, live music, hiking and museums.
The hotel is family-friendly, with a dedicated kids' menu at High Bar.
Pets are welcome regardless of size, weight or breed, at no extra charge.
The roof deck is limited to hotel guests during the day and opens to the public in the evening.
The crew puts out complimentary coffee in the morning and hosts a free nightly wine hour.

highlights.text: The hotel has an outdoor venue with six pickleball courts, adjacent to the hotel and available exclusively for hotel guests.
Rooms use tiled walls as headboards, with light-wood floors and framed topographical maps, a modern look that honors the city's midcentury roots.
The King Spa Suite has balconies and soaking tubs set within its spa showers.
4 Saints is a rooftop restaurant and bar seven stories up that serves creative cocktails and California wines.
The hotel was built from the ground up as part of a downtown revitalization project that demolished a vacant old shopping center.

considerations.text: Those wanting a more private, off-the-beaten-path location will likely want to look elsewhere.
Parking is valet and is included in the resort fee.
The hotel has a mix of guests, often including many business travelers attending meetings and conferences, and travelers with pets.
